resources.string: Choose tools and describe the task. Each operation needs approval. Leaving stops it unless you enable bounded background mode. Files are limited to selected text, Markdown, JSON or CSV up to 64 KiB; document providers may use their own network. Locking always stops the task. Tasks are not saved automatically.
